tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (15.0:1).

tokens.name: justice-black
tokens.usage: Judicial robes, impartial authority, solemn dignity. Used as background on `.stat-card`, `.opinion-card`.

tokens.name: stone-800
tokens.usage: Courthouse stone, institutional permanence. Used as background on `.stat-card`, `.case-table`, `.form-grid`.

tokens.name: marble-white
tokens.usage: Marble columns, purity of justice, clarity. Used as text on `body`, `.header h1`, `.nav a`. 15.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: marble-100
tokens.usage: Pristine documents, constitutional text.

tokens.name: gavel-brown
tokens.usage: Mahogany gavel, judicial authority, tradition. Used as border on `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`.

tokens.name: seal-gold
tokens.usage: Court seal, prestigious certification, excellence. Used as text on `.header::after`, `.header .subtitle`, `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`. 5.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: constitution-cream
tokens.usage: Aged parchment, founding documents, legal history.

tokens.name: law-navy
tokens.usage: Legal authority, trust, procedural order. Used as background on `.badge-majority`.

tokens.name: chamber-gray
tokens.usage: Courtroom walls, neutral impartiality. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.case-party`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: verdict-green
tokens.usage: Favorable ruling, justice served. Used as background on `.badge-granted`.

tokens.name: dissent-red
tokens.usage: Dissenting opinion, critical analysis. Used as background on `.badge-denied`.
